_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'COMMUNICATIONS MANAGEMENT PLAN' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.07.01.

f01_Stakeholder_Group_and_Information_Ne.label: Stakeholder Group and Information Needs
f01_Stakeholder_Group_and_Information_Ne.guidance: Identification of key stakeholder groups and their specific information, governance, and reporting requirements.

f02_Communication_Purpose_and_Language.label: Communication Purpose and Language
f02_Communication_Purpose_and_Language.guidance: The explicit intent of communication and designated working language for project artifacts.

f03_Approved_Communication_Channels_and_.label: Approved Communication Channels and Tools
f03_Approved_Communication_Channels_and_.guidance: Designated platforms (email, intranet, project portal, status dashboards) used for distribution.

f04_Confidentiality_and_Information_Secu.label: Confidentiality and Information Security Constraints
f04_Confidentiality_and_Information_Secu.guidance: Access control guidelines, NDAs, and security protocols governing sensitive project data.

f05_Communication_Item_and_Target_Audien.label: Communication Item and Target Audience
f05_Communication_Item_and_Target_Audien.guidance: Specific report or meeting artifact (e.g., Weekly Status Report, Executive Steering Deck) and recipients.

f06_Frequency_Format_and_Responsible_Sen.label: Frequency, Format, and Responsible Sender
f06_Frequency_Format_and_Responsible_Sen.guidance: Distribution cadence, file format (PDF, dashboard), and assigned sender responsible for delivery.

f07_Urgent_Escalation_Process.section: Escalation Paths and Project Terminology Glossary
f07_Urgent_Escalation_Process.label: Urgent Escalation Process
f07_Urgent_Escalation_Process.guidance: Step-by-step protocol for escalating critical issues, budget alerts, and schedule delays to executive leadership.

f08_Project_Terminology_and_Acronym_Glos.section: Escalation Paths and Project Terminology Glossary
f08_Project_Terminology_and_Acronym_Glos.label: Project Terminology and Acronym Glossary
f08_Project_Terminology_and_Acronym_Glos.guidance: Standard glossary defining technical acronyms, specialized terms, and abbreviations used across project documents.
